transformations: Eight sex-by-Braak cell means, brain region, age, PMI, APOE4 and stated scan/composition terms; donor blocking; full-background robust moderation before 16 non-Y target extraction; late one-df and overall three-df tests have separate BH families.
Primary tissue models use 212 QC-retained arrays. The supplied 213-array matrix was used for target selection and comparisons of processing and QC.
Pass qc_flag=2; FTP tau; amyloid/tau window from configuration; minimum absolute gap, then earlier dates and image identifiers; source conflicts excluded.
AMYLOID_STATUS_COMPOSITE_REF retained; tau positivity >= fixed configured threshold, normally1.34; no outcome-optimized cutoff.
Nearest valid record within configured window; equal-distance ties use earlier date; equal-date conflicting values remain missing.
(ST29SV+ST88SV)/ST10CV; robust three-state MAD outlier flag; numerator/ICV regression sensitivity separate.
Rematch dated amyloid, MRI, diagnosis and CDR before explicit day0 or day180 cutoff; no outcome-time offset predictor.
Same complete common sample and fractional-logit GEE specification; two-year standardized contrast with observed tau IQR and per0.1 normalization.
Half-year windows with past CDR/visit history; fit measured attendance; no cumulative censoring/survival claim; baseline weight1; all planned trims retained.
Four-chain MAR imputations plus prespecified post-imputation covariate offsets; observed cells unchanged; no outcome or death imputation; entire scenario grid retained.
Use rebuilt QC-passed RMA matrix; fit full feature background before extracting targets; correlate tissues within donor; compare baseline, scan-date and CA/NG joint models.
Mean standardized gene-expression score per eligible GO set; joint two-df late-minus0 regional contrasts; not a CAMERA enrichment interaction test.
Omit each donor and each array scan date; refit complete feature background; proportions held fixed from the QC reference deconvolution; checkpoints do not change estimation.
Join every QC-model GO result to complete external families; preserve original full-family external q; missing terms remain unmeasured.
Grouped fivefold paired validation; no training/test participant overlap; actual outcome-visit offset excluded; refit bootstrap uncertainty; site grouping conditional on support.
